mentions.name: Peekl
mentions.description: Peekl is a configuration management tool written in Golang, positioned as an alternative to Ansible and Puppet. It combines Puppet's agent/server model with the ease of writing Ansible code, aiming to fix Puppet's slow catalog application (Ruby running in a JVM) and Ansible's agentless design, which makes deploying at scale time-consuming. It is open source on GitHub, with the author welcoming issues and pull requests.
mentions.problem: Puppet is a slow, decades-old application where applying a catalog can take very long on complex setups, while Ansible's lack of an agent makes it hard to deploy at scale, spending more time running playbooks than doing actual work.
